description.value: Beginning at 1st level, chemists are adept at creating explosive catalysts and infusing them with their magical reserves to create powerful bombs that they can hurl at their enemies. A chemist can infuse a number of catalysts in this manner each day equal to his class level + his Intelligence modifier (a free action). Bombs are unstable, and if not used in the round they are created, they degrade and become inert. A chemist treats his bombs as thrown ammunition for the purposes of drawing and determining how many attacks he can make per round. Thrown bombs have a range increment of 20 feet and use the Throw Splash Weapon special attack. On a direct hit, a chemist's bomb inflicts 1d6 points of fire damage + additional damage equal to the chemist's Intelligence modifier. The damage of a chemist's bomb increases by 1d6 points for every two chemist levels after 1st (2d6 at 3rd, 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 7th, 5d6 at 9th, 6d6 at 11th, 7d6 at 13th, 8d6 at 15th, 9d6 at 17th, 10d6 at 19th). Splash damage from a chemist bomb is always equal to the bomb's minimum damage. Those caught in the splash damage can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + half of the chemist's level + his Intelligence modifier. Chemists can learn new types of bombs as discoveries as they level up. A chemist's bomb becomes inert if used or carried by anyone else.
